# M3-4: Headless claude runner

- Milestone: M3
- Branch / worktree: `t/M3-4`, `../YNAB_AutoCategorizer.wt/M3-4`
- Depends on: M3-2
- Touches (exclusive while running): llm/
- Plan refs: §5a (classifier site and auth probe), spikes/claude-cli.md §Final command lines, claude-cli-review.md, claude-cli-review-4b.md
- YNAB access: none
- Deploy: no (smoke: none; ships in M3-17)

## Goal
`llm/` runs the pinned `claude` CLI safely for the classifier second opinion and the daily auth probe.

## Scope
- Every call, exactly: absolute path to pinned `claude` 2.1.312, `--model haiku`, prompt on **stdin** (never argv), cwd an empty dedicated directory,
  env limited to `DISABLE_UPDATES=1 CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY=1 CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_MDS=1 CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN=…` plus what the binary
  needs (`HOME`, `PATH`, `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`). Build the env from an allowlist so `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` can't pass through. Not `--bare`.
- Classifier flags, exactly: `-p --model haiku --output-format json --tools "" --strict-mcp-config --setting-sources "" --disable-slash-commands
  --no-session-persistence --json-schema <schema>`. No `--max-turns 1`. No MCP.
- Success ⇔ `rc==0 && !.is_error && .structured_output != null`. Anything else, including `is_error:false` with null output, is an error.
- Batches of about 10 (`{results:[{id,category,p}]}`); every id must come back exactly once; an unknown category fails the batch.
- Implement `classify.Model` with this.
- `Probe`: prompt exactly `Reply with exactly: ok` on stdin (a bare "ok" made Haiku chat in M0-4b), with `-p --model haiku --output-format json --tools "" --strict-mcp-config --setting-sources "" --disable-slash-commands --no-session-persistence --max-turns 1` (no `--json-schema`, so `--max-turns 1` is allowed here). Passes only if `rc==0 && !.is_error && trimmed lowercase .result == "ok"`; on failure it returns `api_error_status`.
- Single-worker queue, timeout plus one retry, ctx cancellation kills the child process.
- Exec behind an interface with a fake. Env-gated `CLAUDE_LIVE=1` test.

## Out of scope
- The Slack free-text call site, `--resume`, `--mcp-config` (M5). Dockerfile (M3-17).

## Acceptance (each must be demonstrably checked)
- [ ] Test: exact argv for the classifier call, with no prompt text on argv.
- [ ] Test: child env has no `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` even when the parent sets it; cwd is the empty directory.
- [ ] Table test: nonzero rc, `is_error:true`, null structured output, duplicate id, missing id and unknown category all return errors.
- [ ] Test: exact probe argv and stdin, including `--max-turns 1`.
- [ ] Table test: probe accepts `" OK\n"`, rejects `"not ok"`, rc 1 and `is_error:true` (with 401 surfaced).
- [ ] Test: cancelling ctx ends the child; errors never contain the token or the prompt.
- [ ] go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... green

## Result
- Status: DONE
- What changed:
  - `llm/runner.go`: `Runner` (`New(Config)`): absolute binary path required, `WorkDir` created 0700 and checked empty at
    `New` and before every attempt, env built from an allowlist (the 3 `DISABLE`/`CLAUDE_CODE_*` vars + token, then only
    `HOME`, `PATH`, `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` from the parent). Single-worker slot (ctx-aware), per-attempt timeout (default 90s)
    plus one retry. `CallError{Reason, ExitCode, APIErrorStatus}` carries fixed text only.
  - `llm/exec.go`, `exec_unix.go`: `Execer` interface + `OSExec` (own process group; ctx cancel SIGKILLs the group,
    `WaitDelay` 2s; stdout/stderr capped at 4 MiB; never inherits env).
  - `llm/classifier.go`: `Classifier` implements `classify.Model`; batches of 10, per-batch schema (`id` 1..n,
    `category` enum = candidate names, `p` 0..1); prompt (instructions + JSON DATA block) on stdin. Validates every id
    exactly once, known category, p in range. Prediction: chosen category at p, others 0, `Top` = [category],
    `Model` = `claude-cli-2.1.312/haiku`.
  - `llm/probe.go`: `Runner.Probe`, exact argv incl. `--max-turns 1`, stdin `Reply with exactly: ok`.
  - Tests: `llm/llm_test.go` (fake Execer + real-exec tests with shell-script stand-ins), `llm/live_test.go` (`CLAUDE_LIVE=1`).
- Acceptance:
  - Exact classifier argv, no prompt text on argv → pass (`TestClassify_ExactArgvAndStdin`)
  - No `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` in child env even when parent sets it; cwd is the empty dir → pass (`TestRunner_EnvAllowlistAndCwd`
    with the fake, `TestRunner_OSExecEnvAndCwd` through real exec: the child script sees an empty `$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`,
    `pwd` = the work dir, 0 entries)
  - Failure table (nonzero rc, is_error, null/absent structured output, duplicate/missing/unknown id, unknown category,
    p out of range, malformed stdout, exec failure) → pass (`TestClassify_Failures`; each also asserts exactly one retry)
  - Exact probe argv and stdin incl. `--max-turns 1` → pass (`TestProbe_ExactArgvAndStdin`)
  - Probe table: `" OK\n"` accepted; `"not ok"`, rc 1, `is_error:true` with 401 surfaced in `APIErrorStatus` and the
    message → pass (`TestProbe_Table`)
  - Ctx cancel ends the child (and a grandchild it spawned); errors never contain the token or the prompt → pass
    (`TestRunner_CancelKillsChild`; `assertClean` runs on every error, with the fake echoing token and prompt to stderr)
  - `go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...` → pass; `go test -race -count=3 ./llm` → pass
  - Live test: written but NOT run (no `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` in the local env/.env; the token lives on hoid).
    Run: `CLAUDE_LIVE=1 CLAUDE_BIN=<abs path> go test ./llm -run TestLive -v`.
- Deviations from brief:
  - The retry covers every failure (incl. validation errors and a 401), except the caller's ctx ending. Simple and the
    output is nondeterministic; costs one extra ~4s call on a bad token.
  - No `NONE` category in the schema enum (the spike had one): only candidate names, matching "unknown category fails
    the batch". Claude gives only the top choice, so `Probs` has the chosen category at p and the rest at 0.
  - The pinned version isn't checked at runtime (`PinnedVersion` const only); pinning is the image's job (M3-17).
- Follow-ups for backlog:
  - Run `TestLive` on hoid or with a token (M3-17 smoke).
  - Optional: a startup `claude --version` check against `llm.PinnedVersion`.
- Docs follow-ups:
  - CLAUDE.md package roles: add `llm/` (Runner/Classifier/Probe; env allowlist, stdin prompt, empty cwd, single worker,
    timeout+1 retry; errors carry no token/prompt/model text) and the `CLAUDE_LIVE=1` live test line with `CLAUDE_BIN`.
